item.title: Zorin OS 18 Review: I Switched, and I Never Missed Windows
item.description: After ten years on Windows, what scares you most about switching? It's not learning something new—it's that feeling of total disorientation. Zorin OS 18 tackles exactly that.

item.title: Manjaro 26.0 Is Here - Let's Talk About This Linux Distro
item.description: Manjaro 26.0 is officially released with KDE Plasma 6.5, Linux 6.18 kernel and more. Let's check out what's new in this beginner-friendly Arch-based distro.

item.title: Windows 11 25H2 Official ISO Finally Drops! Microsoft Really Made a 'Minor Patch' Version This Time
item.description: Microsoft finally released the Windows 11 25H2 official ISO. While it's just a continuation of 24H2, the grown-to-7GB size makes people curious. From download to installation, including all the pitfalls, this article helps you figure out whether this 'not-so-major' update is worth upgrading to.
